meta.note: Three layers, named as in the Figma kit. Foundations: raw values (palette mauve-700, space-24, radius-20, size-44). Semantic: the Figma 'Salmon Design' names (color-secondary, space-card-pad-lg, radius-card, size-icon-md), each pointing at a foundation. Roles: the Figma 'Salmon WF' names for colour (color-text-muted, color-background-sunken, color-border-strong), pointing at semantic tokens. Screens use semantic and role tokens only. Figma paths become hyphens: space/card/pad-lg → space-card-pad-lg. Values come from production (the prototype); where Figma differs, the note says so.
